refusals.title: Unable to compute static value
refusals.what: Something an identity argument, a count or a for_each depends on could not be computed. It is the trailing half of another refusal: the diagnostic before it names what actually failed, and this one names the chain that led there.

refusals.title: Resource type is outside the live-markers subset
Dynamic value in static context
refusals.what: An identity argument, a count or a for_each reads a value that only exists once something has been applied: another resource's attribute, or a data source. It is the catch-all of the static-context checks - a module output and a provider function each get their own refusal instead.

refusals.title: Unresolvable identity
refusals.what: An identity could not be built because a reference it depends on failed; the reference's own error explains why.

refusals.title: count.index is not available in resource arguments

refusals.id: Module output not supported in static context
refusals.title: Module output not supported in static context
refusals.what: An identity argument, a count or a for_each reads a child module's output. Module outputs are produced by evaluating the module, which has not happened yet.
refusals.docs_ref: live/LIMITATIONS.md, "Module output not supported in static context"

refusals.title: Provisioners are not available under live resource markers
Null identity argument
refusals.what: An identity argument evaluates to null.

refusals.title: Identity argument not set
refusals.what: The argument carrying this type's identity has no value - most often a *_prefix argument used in place of the name itself.

refusals.title: Not an identity attribute
refusals.what: An identity argument reads an attribute of another resource that is not part of that resource's identity.

refusals.title: Invalid for_each set
refusals.what: A for_each set's element type is not a string.

refusals.title: Identity not resolvable from configuration
refusals.what: An identity argument reads something resolution cannot follow: a value through a function or operator, an indexed or two-step traversal, an ephemeral resource, or a root it does not evaluate.

refusals.title: Module provider mapping is not honoured
This module call cannot be expanded under live resource markers
moved blocks are not available under live resource markers
Non-static for_each expression
refusals.what: A for_each expression cannot be resolved from configuration alone - computed from another resource's attributes, or reading a root that is not statically evaluable.

refusals.title: Ambiguous attribute key
refusals.what: An object key in a statically evaluated expression is a bare name that could be either a variable reference or a literal string, so which was meant cannot be decided.

refusals.id: Attempt to get attribute from null value
refusals.title: Attempt to get attribute from null value
refusals.what: An identity argument, a count or a for_each reads an attribute of something that evaluated to null.
refusals.docs_ref: live/LIMITATIONS.md, "Attempt to get attribute from null value"

refusals.title: Attempt to index null value
refusals.what: An identity argument, a count or a for_each indexes into something that evaluated to null.

refusals.title: Call to unknown function
refusals.what: A statically evaluated expression calls a function this run does not have. Static evaluation offers the pure standard library only; a provider-defined function needs a running provider.

refusals.title: Circular for_each reference
refusals.what: A resource's for_each depends on its own instances, directly or through another resource's for_each.

refusals.title: Circular identity reference
refusals.what: A resource's identity is composed, directly or transitively, from its own identity.

refusals.title: Circular reference
refusals.what: A local is defined, directly or transitively, in terms of itself. Only local-to-local cycles are detected here: the static scope pushes a frame when it resolves a local and not when it resolves a variable.

refusals.title: Condition is null
refusals.what: A conditional inside a statically evaluated expression has a null condition, so neither branch can be chosen.

refusals.id: Configuration loaded without a static evaluator
refusals.title: Configuration loaded without a static evaluator
refusals.what: The configuration was not loaded through configs.Parser.LoadConfigDir or the configload package. A caller error, not a configuration one.
refusals.docs_ref: live/LIMITATIONS.md, "Configuration loaded without a static evaluator"

refusals.title: Duplicate object key
refusals.what: An object constructor in a statically evaluated expression sets the same key twice.

refusals.title: Ephemeral value not allowed
refusals.what: A module source or a backend argument resolves to an ephemeral value. It is raised while decoding those two expressions, not during identity resolution: an ephemeral value in an identity argument is refused by identity itself, under "Identity derived from a sensitive value".

refusals.title: Error in function call
refusals.what: A function inside a statically evaluated expression returned an error - jsondecode over text that is not JSON, for instance.

refusals.title: Expression not evaluable here
refusals.what: Static evaluation of an identity argument panicked and was recovered; most often an expression inside a keyed module resolving, several layers down, back to the module call's own each.key or each.value.

refusals.title: Failed to get working directory
refusals.what: path.cwd could not be resolved because the operating system refused the working directory. An environment failure, not a configuration one.

refusals.title: Function calls not allowed
refusals.what: A function is called where the surrounding context permits none at all.

refusals.id: Identity derived from a sensitive value
refusals.title: Identity derived from a sensitive value
refusals.what: An identity argument reads a sensitive or ephemeral value. Import identities are written to logs and plan output, so neither can be part of one.
refusals.docs_ref: live/LIMITATIONS.md, "Identity derived from a sensitive value"

refusals.id: Identity derived from an impure function
refusals.title: Identity derived from an impure function
refusals.what: An identity argument calls uuid(), timestamp() or bcrypt(), which return a different value on every evaluation.
refusals.docs_ref: live/LIMITATIONS.md, "Identity derived from an impure function"

refusals.id: Identity table and provider schema disagree
refusals.title: Identity table and provider schema disagree
refusals.what: The identity table and the installed provider's schema differ about a type in a way that is not fatal; reported as a warning.
refusals.docs_ref: live/LIMITATIONS.md, "Identity table and provider schema disagree"

refusals.title: Inconsistent conditional result types
refusals.what: A conditional's two branches produce types that cannot be reconciled into one.

refusals.title: Incorrect condition type
refusals.what: A conditional's condition is not a boolean and cannot be converted to one - most often a string used where a bool was meant.

refusals.title: Incorrect key type
refusals.what: A map or object is indexed with a key of the wrong type.

refusals.title: Invalid "path" attribute
refusals.what: path is read with an attribute other than cwd, module or root.

refusals.title: Invalid "terraform" attribute
refusals.what: terraform is read with an attribute other than workspace, including the terraform.env removed in v0.12.

refusals.title: Invalid 'for' condition
refusals.what: A for expression's if clause does not evaluate to a boolean.

refusals.title: Invalid attribute in static context
refusals.what: terraform.applying is read where only configuration is available; it has a value during plan and apply, and none here.

refusals.title: Invalid count
refusals.what: A count expression is not a whole non-negative number.

refusals.id: Invalid default value for module argument
refusals.title: Invalid default value for module argument
refusals.what: A variable's default does not fit its own type constraint, so no value for it can be produced.
refusals.docs_ref: live/LIMITATIONS.md, "Invalid default value for module argument"

refusals.title: Invalid expanding argument value
refusals.what: A function call expands an argument with ... over something that is not a list or tuple.

refusals.title: Invalid for_each value
refusals.what: A for_each value is neither a map nor a set of strings.

refusals.title: Invalid function argument
refusals.what: A function inside a statically evaluated expression was given an argument of the wrong type or an unacceptable value.

refusals.title: Invalid index
refusals.what: A collection is indexed out of range, or with a key it does not have.

refusals.title: Invalid index key
refusals.what: A reference indexes a resource or module with a key this fork's address parser cannot read - one that is not a literal string or whole number.

refusals.title: Invalid nested splat expressions
refusals.what: Two splat expressions are nested, which has no defined meaning.

refusals.title: Invalid object key
refusals.what: An object constructor's key does not evaluate to a string and cannot be converted to one.

refusals.title: Invalid operand
refusals.what: An operator inside a statically evaluated expression was given an operand of the wrong type - arithmetic on a string, for instance.

refusals.title: Invalid path step
refusals.what: A traversal steps into a value in a way its type does not support.

refusals.title: Invalid reference
refusals.what: A reference is not a shape this fork's address parser recognises at all - an operator, an index, or a traversal into something that has no attributes.

refusals.title: Invalid template interpolation value
refusals.what: A ${...} interpolation produces a value with no string form, such as a list or an object.

refusals.title: Invalid value for input variable
refusals.what: The value supplied for a variable does not convert to its declared type.

refusals.title: Iteration over non-iterable value
refusals.what: A for expression iterates over something that is not a collection.

refusals.title: Iteration over null value
refusals.what: A for expression iterates over null.

refusals.title: Missing map element
refusals.what: A map is indexed with a key it does not contain.

refusals.title: No configuration to resolve
refusals.what: Resolution was handed an empty configuration. A caller error, not a configuration one.

refusals.title: No configuration to scan
refusals.what: Signal collection was handed an empty configuration. A caller error, not a configuration one.

refusals.title: Non-static count expression
refusals.what: A count expression evaluates to null, or to a value not knowable from configuration alone.

refusals.title: Non-static identity argument
refusals.what: An identity argument cannot be evaluated from configuration alone, including an impure call reached through a local or written in .tf.json.

refusals.title: Non-static lifecycle.enabled expression
refusals.what: A lifecycle.enabled expression cannot be resolved from configuration alone.

refusals.title: Non-string identity argument
refusals.what: An identity argument evaluates to a value that is not a string.

refusals.title: Not enough function arguments
refusals.what: A function inside a statically evaluated expression was called with too few arguments.

refusals.title: Null condition
refusals.what: A for expression's if clause evaluates to null.

refusals.title: Null value as key
refusals.what: A null is used as an object or map key.

refusals.title: Operation failed
refusals.what: An arithmetic or comparison operator inside a statically evaluated expression failed - division by zero, for instance.

refusals.title: Provider function in static context
refusals.what: A statically evaluated expression calls a provider-defined function, which needs a configured provider this run has not started.

refusals.id: Reference to a module instance that does not exist
refusals.title: Reference to a module instance that does not exist
refusals.what: A reference names a module instance the configuration does not expand to.
refusals.docs_ref: live/LIMITATIONS.md, "Reference to a module instance that does not exist"

refusals.id: Reference to a resource instance that does not exist
refusals.title: Reference to a resource instance that does not exist
refusals.what: A reference names an instance key the target resource does not expand to, or omits one it requires.
refusals.docs_ref: live/LIMITATIONS.md, "Reference to a resource instance that does not exist"

refusals.title: Reference to undeclared resource
refusals.what: A reference, or a for_each parent, names a resource the module does not declare.

refusals.title: Required variable not set
refusals.what: A non-nullable variable with no default was given no value, so nothing depending on it can be evaluated.

refusals.title: Reserved symbol name
refusals.what: A reference uses a name this fork reserves for future use, so it cannot be read as a reference to anything that exists.

refusals.id: Resource type has no orphan recovery
refusals.title: Resource type has no orphan recovery
refusals.what: The type is admitted by the provider's identity schema rather than by the generated admission table, so it plans and applies but the estate-wide sweep will not list it: deleting its last block leaves the live resource with no run proposing to remove it. Reported as a warning.
refusals.docs_ref: live/LIMITATIONS.md, "Resource type has no orphan recovery"

refusals.id: Resource type outside the live-markers subset
refusals.title: Resource type outside the live-markers subset
refusals.what: The type is absent from the admission table, and neither the provider's identity schema nor the configuration's own arguments settle its identity.

refusals.title: Sensitive count expression
refusals.what: A count expression reads a sensitive or ephemeral value; the instance keys it produces become marker values.

refusals.title: Sensitive for_each expression
refusals.what: A for_each expression reads a sensitive or ephemeral value; instance keys become marker values, which are written to the cloud.

refusals.title: Sensitive lifecycle.enabled expression
refusals.what: A lifecycle.enabled expression reads a sensitive or ephemeral value, so whether the resource exists is decided by something this run may not record.

refusals.title: Sensitive value not allowed
refusals.what: A module source or a backend argument resolves to a sensitive value. Same decoding step as the ephemeral case above, and not the one an identity argument goes through.

refusals.title: Splat of null value
refusals.what: A splat expression is applied to null.

refusals.id: The identity table names something the provider does not have
refusals.title: The identity table names something the provider does not have
refusals.what: The identity table builds a type's identity from an argument the installed provider's schema has no such name for; usually provider-version skew.
refusals.docs_ref: live/LIMITATIONS.md, "The identity table names something the provider does not have"

refusals.title: Too many function arguments
refusals.what: A function inside a statically evaluated expression was called with too many arguments.

refusals.id: Two resources with the same identity
refusals.title: Two resources with the same identity
refusals.what: Two resource blocks resolve to one identity, so one live object would have two owners.

refusals.title: Unable to parse provider function
refusals.what: A provider:: function reference is not in the form the address parser accepts.

refusals.id: Unable to use variable in static context
refusals.title: Unable to use variable in static context
refusals.what: A variable declared const = false is read where only configuration is available.
refusals.docs_ref: live/LIMITATIONS.md, "Unable to use variable in static context"

refusals.title: Undefined local
refusals.what: A reference names a local the module does not declare.

refusals.title: Undefined variable
refusals.what: A reference names a variable the module does not declare.

refusals.title: Unknown variable
refusals.what: A reference names a symbol that reached evaluation with nothing bound to it - most often each or count read where this run does not supply repetition data.

refusals.title: Unsupported attribute
refusals.what: A statically evaluated expression reads an attribute the value does not have.

refusals.title: Unsupported each.value reference
refusals.what: each.value is used as other than each.value.<attr> when for_each iterates over a resource.

refusals.title: Variables not allowed
refusals.what: A reference appears where the surrounding context permits no variables at all.

refusals.id: for_each key cannot be recorded as a marker
refusals.title: for_each key cannot be recorded as a marker
refusals.what: A for_each key contains a character the tofu-address marker cannot carry.

refusals.id: for_each over a resource that is not keyed
refusals.title: for_each over a resource that is not keyed
refusals.what: for_each iterates a resource that has no instance keys to iterate - one expanded with count, or one using neither count nor for_each.
refusals.docs_ref: live/LIMITATIONS.md, "for_each over a resource that is not keyed"

refusals.title: Live configuration in a child module is not consulted
for_each key is outside the marker character set
Provider block in a child module is not consulted
Resource address does not fit in a marker
Delete quadrant has no scope block
Policy threshold is not a positive number
Policy verb is not valid for its quadrant
Nothing may reference a receipt's attributes
Receipt inputs reference secrets by pointer, never by value
A receipt's value is a hash or a constant, and its type is never SecureString
refusals.docs_ref: live/RECEIPTS.md, "Guard 2. Hash-only values, and never SecureString"

refusals.title: terraform_remote_state is not available under live resource markers
State backends are not available under live resource markers
